| `saveWeatherToCache(string $cacheKey, array $weather)` | Save weather to cache |
| `fetchWeatherFromApi(float $lat, float $lng)` | Fetch weather from Open-Meteo API |
| `parseWeatherResponse(array $data)` | Parse API response into a cleaner format |
| `getWeatherDescription(int $code)` | Get weather description from WMO code |
| `getWeatherIcon(int $code)` | Get weather icon emoji from WMO code |
| `calculateBeachScore(array $current)` | Calculate beach score (0-100) based on current conditions |
| `getUVLevel(float $uvIndex)` | Get UV index level and safety message |
| `getWindDirection(int $degrees)` | Get wind direction as compass point |
| `formatSunTime(string $isoTime)` | Format sunrise/sunset time |
| `getBeachRecommendation(array $weather)` | Get beach day recommendation based on weather |
| `getBatchWeatherForBeaches(array $beaches, int $limit = 20)` | Batch fetch weather for multiple beaches efficiently |
